title: Let It Go or Learn to Self-Correct: Continuous Diffusion for Constrained Discrete Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2609.09009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) generate samples by starting from noise and repeatedly denoising while keeping each update close to the current noisy state. This behavior is effective in many continuous domains, but its role is less clear for globally constrained discrete tasks, such as Sudoku, graph connectivity, Latin squares, and N-queens. In such settings, early discrete errors can be difficult to undo. As a result, standard diffusion sampling may preserve early mistakes, even when the model's clean predictions are informative. We compare standard samplers to sampling directly from the model's clean prediction. Without retraining, this single change improves Sudoku validity from 31% to 95%, with consistent gains across the other discrete tasks. translated_title: 放手还是学会自我纠错：面向约束离散任务的连续扩散模型
translated_abstract: 去噪扩散概率模型（DDPMs）通过从噪声开始并反复去噪来生成样本，同时保持每次更新接近当前的含噪状态。这种行为在许多连续域中是有效的，但其对于全局约束的离散任务（如数独、图连通性、拉丁方和N皇后问题）的作用尚不清楚。在这类场景中，早期的离散错误很难被撤销。因此，标准的扩散采样可能会保留早期的错误，即使模型输出的干净预测本身具有足够的信息量。我们将标准采样器与直接从模型的干净预测进行采样的方法进行了比较。在无需重新训练的情况下，仅这一项改变就将数独的有效率从31%提升到了95%，并在其他离散任务上也取得了一致的提升。我们假设，保持接近当前含噪状态是有害的，因为反向轨迹可能会偏离模型训练时所基于的正向加噪分布。
tldr: 研究发现，在数独等全局约束的离散任务中，直接从扩散模型的干净预测进行采样（而非逐步去噪采样），无需重新训练即可将数独有效率从31%大幅提升至95%，因为标准扩散采样中保持接近含噪状态会固化早期错误并使反向轨迹偏离训练分布。
en_tdlr: Sampling directly from the diffusion model's clean prediction, instead of standard gradual denoising, improves Sudoku validity from 31% to 95% without retraining on constrained discrete tasks, since staying close to the noisy state preserves early mistakes and drifts off the training distribution.
